product: AI meeting notes for sales teams
rules: Every requirement must map to at least one design decision.
Every requirement must map to at least one task.
Every task must map to at least one validation command or evidence requirement.
Every current-world claim must map to a research ledger source.
Reference and bad cases must declare provenance.
Architecture decisions must cite research and explain real pain, stage fit, one-year debt, team scaling cost, and rollback.
Frontend, backend, data, and algorithm decisions must trace to research and architecture fitness checks when those surfaces exist.
Cache consistency and data access/index contracts must define source of truth, invalidation, permissions, and validation.
Task prompt packets must specify role, context, task, constraints, output, and validation evidence.
Architecture workstream prompt packets must split frontend, backend, data, and algorithm work when those surfaces exist.
Implementation changes to behavior, API, schema, permissions, security, visual contract, or eval evidence must update upstream docs before completion.
